## Changes

Describe the change and why it is needed. Use a Conventional Commit PR title, e.g. `fix: preserve source provenance`.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:install` and `npm run test:pi` when behavior or dependencies change
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation
- [ ] No credentials, production memory state or unrelated generated files included

Note limitations or checks you could not run. A green job does not prove memory accuracy or full product acceptance.
